en: The postcard displays a collage of images: a crowded sandy beach with sunbathers and umbrellas, groups of people dressed in traditional folk costumes participating in what appears to be a wedding ceremony or celebration, and two scenes of tables set with traditional pottery and food, likely in a restaurant or outdoor dining area. The predominant motif emphasizes Bulgarian culture and hospitality.
